scenes.title: Got a raise? Do this first.
scenes.say: Got a raise? Do this before you spend it.

scenes.label: a year: half of a $5,000 raise, saved
scenes.say: Say you get a five thousand dollar raise. Save half. That's twenty five hundred a year.

scenes.title: After 10 years at 7%
scenes.say: Over ten years, that's twenty five thousand saved. Invested at seven percent, about thirty four and a half.

scenes.title: Enjoy half. Invest half.
scenes.say: Enjoy half, invest half. Follow for more money math.
